name: Form
description: Configurable form whose field list is authored as content. Submissions are forwarded by email to the site's recipients and are never stored anywhere.
when_to_use: Any page that needs to collect structured input the editor defines — contact, callback request, enquiry, registration of interest. Use Contact instead when the page needs an address/phone info block beside a fixed contact form, and Cta's inline-form variant for a lightweight name+email capture.
capabilities: editor-defined field list (text, email, tel, number, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, date)
per-field required flag, placeholder and half/full width
submissions emailed to site recipients — never stored
optional confirmation copy to the visitor
honest error state with a fallback email address when sending fails

variants.description: Header above a centered form. Default.
Header and intro left, form right.
Form in a raised card on a tinted band.

breakpoints.mobile: Everything stacks; half-width fields go full width.
breakpoints.desktop: Two-column split for the split variant; half-width fields pair up on one row.

ai.prompt_summary: Form: a form whose fields are content. Settings: variant (stacked|split|card), eyebrow, headline, intro, form_key (generated — never edit), submit_label, success_text, consent_text, privacy_link, recipients (comma-separated, verified addresses only), send_confirmation. fields[]: { identifier (required, lowercase key), label (required), type (text|email|tel|number|textarea|select|checkbox|radio|date), placeholder, required, width (full|half), options[] { label, value } for select/radio }. Create it with the create_form tool, not add_block — create_form generates the form_key.
ai.content_guidelines: Ask what the user wants to collect before proposing fields. Keep forms short — 3 to 5 fields converts far better than 10. Always include an email field, otherwise the client cannot reply. Label in the site's language. success_text should promise a concrete response time.

field_hints.form_key: Generated by create_form and used by the broker to match submissions to this form. Changing it silently breaks the form.
field_hints.recipients: Leave empty to use the site default. Only addresses on the site's verified list are honoured.
field_hints.send_confirmation: Off by default. It sends a second email per submission and consumes the same monthly quota.
field_hints.fields: identifier must be unique within the form and is what appears as the label in the notification email.
field_hints.privacy_link: Required in practice for German sites — link the Datenschutz page.
